name: OR-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Maxine Dexter running with over $1 million raised
Republican challenger Loran Ayles has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: Portland-based OR-03 carries a +24 Democratic lean, Dexter is an incumbent who has raised over $1 million, and her opponent shows no measurable fundraising or outside support. Markets price her at 96%, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: A surprise influx of outside spending against Dexter or a major scandal would be the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Maxine Dexter, a Democratic incumbent first elected in 2024, is seeking a second term in a Portland-area district that leans 24 points Democratic. She has raised more than $1 million for the race, while Republican challenger Loran Ayles reports no fundraising on file and no outside groups are active in the contest.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings exist for the race, but prediction markets give Dexter roughly a 96% chance of winning. With the fundamentals, money, and market pricing all aligned, this seat is rated Safe Democratic.
